data.headline: Global market intelligence dashboard
data.summary: Snapshot-first research dashboard for public, source-gated intelligence. It highlights monitored sectors, central-bank calendars, scenario baskets, and approved events without personalized advice.

top_events.title: Semiconductor export-control monitoring remains elevated
top_events.summary: Approved seed event links export-control risk to advanced chips, foundry exposure, and Asia supply chains.
top_events.why_it_matters: The effect can propagate through AI accelerator availability, capex timing, and country exposure.

top_events.title: Energy inventory calendar is active for oil supply monitoring
top_events.summary: EIA-linked inventory releases are tracked as official structured data before publication.
top_events.why_it_matters: Inventory surprises can affect energy equities, inflation inputs, and geopolitical risk interpretation.

top_events.title: Central-bank calendar coverage seeded across six policy committees
top_events.summary: FOMC, ECB, BoE, BoJ, BoK, and Brazil COPOM are represented with explicit expectation labels.
top_events.why_it_matters: Calendar visibility reduces silent coverage gaps and makes stale policy data visible.
